title: Cimpress to Host Virtual Investor Day on September 30, 2026
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Cimpress plc's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
[PDF Version](https://ir.cimpress.com/node/26096/pdf)


DUNDALK, Ireland--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 9, 2026-- Cimpress plc (Nasdaq: CMPR) will host its 2026 annual Investor Day on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 from 8:00 am ET to 11:00 am ET. Investors can access the virtual, live video event from Cimpress’ investor relations website at[ir.cimpress.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.cimpress.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents&esheet=54600569&newsitemid=20260909972634&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.cimpress.com&index=1&md5=452cc61b43f082b1630ac695cb6a6dde) . The event will feature presentations from executives across Cimpress highlighting the company’s progress against our strategic goals and financial priorities, as well as panel discussions covering topics including how manufacturing excellence and AI are driving efficiency and growth across our businesses.


Investors are encouraged to pre-submit questions for the panel discussions and Q&A portion of the event by emailingir@cimpress.com . There will also be an opportunity to ask live questions via chat during the webcast.


A replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the event concludes on our events page at[ir.cimpress.com/news-and-events/events](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.cimpress.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents&esheet=54600569&newsitemid=20260909972634&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.cimpress.com%2Fnews-and-events%2Fevents&index=2&md5=af2c66e285dfec858561db787d2d901c) .


**About Cimpress** Cimpress plc (Nasdaq: CMPR) helps millions of businesses build brands, stand out, and grow via customized physical marketing products and branded merchandise. Founded in 1995, Cimpress is the global leader in web-to-print mass customization, delivering high-quality, affordable custom products quickly and conveniently—even in low quantities. Cimpress brands include VistaPrint, WIRmachenDRUCK, Pixartprinting, Pens.com, BuildASign, druck.at, Saxoprint, Drukwerkdeal, easyflyer, Exaprint, Packstyle, Printi, Tradeprint and BoxUp. To learn more, visit[cimpress.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fcimpress.com%2F&esheet=54600569&newsitemid=20260909972634&lan=en-US&anchor=cimpress.com&index=3&md5=d28ee99743a14bde7e8f3e0be889ae19) .
